providers.name: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash
providers.description: Google's latest Gemini 2.5 Flash model (stable, June 2025). Ultra-fast, multimodal, 1M token context, and excellent at multilingual understanding. Native Google Translate integration for superior casual/slang comprehension. Best for real-time WhatsApp chat.

providers.name: Ollama Gemini 3 Flash
providers.description: Google's speed-optimized frontier model. Trained on Google Translate corpus — excels at understanding casual/slang multilingual input ('eh bro wifi pass apa'). Different architecture from Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek, so may succeed when others fail. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Groq Llama 3.3 70B
providers.description: Balanced quality/speed (280 tok/s). Meta's workhorse 70B model with 131K context. Reliable for chat responses, good multilingual understanding. Proven stable fallback.

providers.name: Ollama GPT-OSS 20B
providers.description: Fastest cloud model via Ollama (~3s). GPT-4 class quality with visible chain-of-thought. No rate limits, no API key needed. Best default for all tasks.

providers.name: Groq Llama 3.1 8B Instant
providers.description: Ultra-fast (560 tok/s) — fastest on Groq. Purpose-built for latency-critical apps. Small but reliable for structured JSON intent classification. Best as a quick classification fallback.

providers.name: Groq Qwen3 32B
providers.description: Alibaba's trilingual specialist (400 tok/s). Native Chinese tokenization (3x more efficient than Llama for CJK). Trained on substantial Malay/Indonesian corpus. Supports thinking mode. Best for Chinese and Malay guest conversations.

providers.name: Ollama DeepSeek V3.2
providers.description: ~685B MoE reasoning model. Successor to V3.1 with balanced compute allocation — spends more effort on hard sub-questions, less on easy ones. Better at following complex multi-rule system prompts. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Ollama Qwen3 80B
providers.description: Alibaba's parameter-efficient 80B general model. Redesigned transformer for 80B quality with less compute. Natively bilingual Chinese/English with strong Malay. Upgrade from Qwen3 32B for harder multilingual queries. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Groq Llama 4 Scout 17B
providers.description: Meta's newest Llama 4 (750 tok/s). First Llama with MoE — only ~4B params active per token despite 17B total. Near-8B speed with much better quality. Natively trained for multi-turn conversation. Best speed/quality ratio for chat.

providers.name: Groq DeepSeek R1 Distill 70B
providers.description: 70B model distilled from DeepSeek R1's 671B reasoning engine (~200 tok/s). Inherits chain-of-thought ability — naturally breaks complex problems into steps. Excels at multi-step logic (date calculations, price comparisons, booking availability). Best for complex guest queries.

providers.name: Moonshot Kimi 2.5
providers.description: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 (262K context). Supports reasoning, images, and video. Premium quality multimodal model for deep analysis. Requires Moonshot API key from platform.moonshot.ai.

providers.name: Qwen 2.5 32B (Free)
providers.description: Alibaba's Qwen 2.5 32B - Strong reasoning, multilingual support, free tier

providers.name: Google Gemma 2 9B (Free)
providers.description: Google's Gemma 2 9B IT - Efficient, instruction-tuned, free tier

providers.name: Meta Llama 3.1 8B (Free)
providers.description: Meta's Llama 3.1 8B - Fast, capable, free tier

providers.name: Mistral 7B (Free)
providers.description: Mistral AI's 7B model - Efficient, high quality, free tier

providers.name: Microsoft Phi-3 Medium (Free)
providers.description: Microsoft Phi-3 Medium - Compact but powerful, free tier

ai.slow_response_message: I'm sorry, all my AI systems are running slowly right now. Please try again in a moment, or contact our staff for immediate help.

ocr_provider.description: LLM model used for passport/IC image extraction (OCR). Google Gemini Flash recommended for its multimodal vision capabilities.

system_prompt: You are Rainbow, a friendly female AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. You always clarify that you are an AI bot when introducing yourself. You help guests with check-in info, pricing, availability, bookings, and general hostel questions. Be warm, concise, and helpful. Reply in the same language as the guest (English, Malay, or Chinese). Keep responses under 300 characters when possible. Sign off with "— Rainbow 🌈" on important messages. If unsure, suggest contacting staff. --- IMPORTANT (US-1009: Malaysia PDPA 2025 Data Notice): Conversations with this AI assistant may be processed by external AI providers (e.g. Google, NVIDIA, Groq) for model inference. Personal data such as phone numbers and conversation context may be transmitted to these providers' servers in different jurisdictions. If you have concerns about data processing, please contact Pelangi staff directly. --- IMPORTANT (US-1026: WhatsApp Business Compliance): You are a business-purpose-only assistant. Your ONLY allowed topics are: bookings, check-in/check-out, room availability, pricing, hostel facilities, cafe menu and food orders, directions, promotions, feedback, and complaints. You must NEVER answer general knowledge questions, write creative content, provide coding help, give personal advice, or act as a general-purpose assistant. If a guest asks about anything outside hostel/cafe operations, politely redirect them to your business services. This is required by Meta WhatsApp Business Platform terms.

conversation_management.description: Token-aware pruning: when context exceeds max_context_tokens (6000), older messages beyond the last keep_recent_turns (4) turns are summarized. summarization_providers: optional list of cheap provider IDs for summarization calls (empty = use default). context_window_alert_threshold: alert when LLM call tokens exceed this fraction of model context window (US-978).

fallback.description: Multi-stage fallback (US-445). First unrecognized message shows suggested options; second consecutive unrecognized triggers escalation.

escalation_messages.en: I sense you may be frustrated. I've alerted our team, and someone will reach out to you shortly.
escalation_messages.ms: Saya faham anda mungkin kecewa. Saya telah maklumkan pasukan kami, dan seseorang akan menghubungi anda tidak lama lagi.
escalation_messages.zh: 我感觉到您可能有些不满。我已通知我们的团队,他们会尽快与您联系。

sentiment_analysis.description: Automatically detect frustrated users and escalate to staff when they send consecutive negative messages

escalation_rules.description: US-914: Structured escalation rules — high-stakes keywords trigger immediate escalation, consecutive low-confidence AI responses escalate after 2 turns

feedback_followup.en: Hi! We'd love to hear your feedback on your stay at Pelangi Capsule Hostel. Reply anytime to chat with Rainbow 🌈
feedback_followup.ms: Hai! Kami ingin mendengar maklum balas anda tentang penginapan di Pelangi Capsule Hostel. Balas bila-bila untuk bersembang dengan Rainbow 🌈
feedback_followup.zh: 您好！我们很想听听您对 Pelangi Capsule Hostel 住宿的反馈。随时回复与 Rainbow 聊天 🌈

business_scope_policy.description: US-1026: Meta WhatsApp Business Platform policy — bots must serve a specific business purpose. No general-purpose assistant mode.

redirectMessage.en: I'm Rainbow, the AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel. I can help with bookings, check-in/out, room info, cafe menu, and hostel facilities. How can I assist you with your stay?
redirectMessage.ms: Saya Rainbow, pembantu AI untuk Pelangi Capsule Hostel. Saya boleh bantu dengan tempahan, daftar masuk/keluar, maklumat bilik, menu kafe, dan kemudahan hostel. Bagaimana saya boleh bantu anda?
redirectMessage.zh: 我是 Rainbow，Pelangi Capsule Hostel 的 AI 助手。我可以帮您处理预订、入住/退房、房间信息、咖啡厅菜单和旅馆设施。请问有什么可以帮您的？

connections.name: PMS2 (Property Management)
connections.description: Pelangi Capsule Hostel property management � guests, units, check-in/out, occupancy, availability, maintenance, reservations, and dashboard analytics. 24 tools via JSON-RPC.

message_queue.description: BullMQ async message queue for decoupling webhook ingestion from processing (US-405). Requires Redis. dedup_ttl_seconds (US-991): how long to remember message IDs for deduplication (default 86400 = 24h).

languageDetection.description: Automatic language detection for incoming messages (US-418). Detects en/ms/zh via ELD + patterns. If confidence < threshold, defaults to defaultLanguage.

promptInjection.safeResponse: I can only help with hostel-related questions. How can I assist you today?
promptInjection.description: Prompt injection detection (US-422). When patterns is empty, built-in defaults are used. Add custom patterns to override.

manual.description: Show AI suggestions when 'Help me' clicked

copilot.description: Auto-approve high-confidence responses for simple intents

response_modes.description: Global default response mode: autopilot (AI auto-sends), copilot (AI suggests, staff approves), or manual (staff writes, AI helps on request)

fallbackReply.en: Sorry, I couldn't understand your voice note. Please type your request.
fallbackReply.ms: Maaf, saya tidak dapat memahami nota suara anda. Sila taip permintaan anda.
fallbackReply.zh: 抱歉，我无法理解您的语音消息。请输入您的请求。

voiceTranscription.description: Voice note transcription via Groq Whisper API (US-438). Set enabled: false per profile to disable.

retention.description: US-907: PDPA 2024 default retention 24 months (730 days). Conversations and message logs older than retention_days are flagged for disposal.

typingIndicator.description: Send WhatsApp typing indicator before LLM responses (T3/T4 paths). Not sent for fast T1 regex matches.

token_prices._comment: Cost per 1K tokens in USD, by model. Used for LLM cost analytics.

costBudget._comment: Per-provider daily cost budget caps in USD (US-433). null = unlimited. Alert at 80%, block at 100%.

providerBudgets._comment: Map of provider ID -> daily budget in USD. Omit or set null for unlimited.

session.description: Context-aware idle session timeout (US-444). When last message is older than idleTimeoutHours, the current conversation is marked 'ended' and a new session starts. If welcomeBackEnabled, bot sends a welcome-back greeting.

webchat_idle.reengagement_message: Are you still there? I'm here to help if you have any more questions! Feel free to ask anytime.
webchat_idle.description: Webchat idle timeout (US-826). Sends re-engagement message after timeout_minutes of inactivity. If no response within reengagement_window_minutes, session marked as timed_out. Webchat only — does NOT apply to WhatsApp. Min timeout: 5 minutes.

interactiveMessages.description: Send WhatsApp interactive list/button messages instead of plain text numbered lists (US-430). When disabled, falls back to plain text.

qualityAlerts.description: WhatsApp message quality score monitoring (US-431). Alerts when opt-out rate exceeds threshold (default 2%). Optional webhook for external alerting.

fallbackAlert.description: Daily fallback rate alert (US-814). Sends WhatsApp alert when AI misunderstanding rate exceeds threshold. threshold is a decimal (0.20 = 20%). recipient defaults to system admin if empty.

chatbot_report.description: Automated daily chatbot performance summary (US-825). Sent to admin WhatsApp at configured time. profile_id empty = cross-profile summary. Only sent if >=1 conversation in last 24h.

features.description: US-840: Per-profile toggle for media message acknowledgement replies. When false, media messages (image/audio/document) are silently ignored instead of replied to.

breach_detection.description: US-907: Anomalous bulk data access detection. Scans for >bulk_access_threshold records accessed per minute from a single session.

biometric_consent.description: US-994: PDPA Amendment Act 2024 Phase 2 — biometric data (facial images from passport/IC) requires explicit consent before OCR processing. When enabled, the system blocks OCR and sends a consent request before processing any ID image.

pdpa.description: US-878/US-907: PDPA 2024 amendment — DPO appointment, breach detection, and data retention. dpo_email and dpo_name are mandatory per Malaysia PDPA Amendment Act 2024 (effective 1 June 2025). DPO must be ordinarily resident in Malaysia and registered with PDPC Commissioner.

order_modification.description: US-881: Post-placement order modification window. Customers can request changes within window_minutes after confirming. Closed early if kitchen accepts via POS webhook.

kds.description: US-1014: Kitchen Display System outbound order push. Sends confirmed orders to KDS via REST API. webhookUrl and webhookAuthToken can also be set via KDS_WEBHOOK_URL and KDS_WEBHOOK_AUTH_TOKEN env vars (env vars take precedence).

cart_recovery.description: US-882: WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery. Sends a proactive message when a WhatsApp session has idle cart items for idle_minutes. Only one message per cart session. Cart auto-clears 24h after recovery message if no response.

billing.description: WhatsApp Business pricing model toggle (US-845). 'per_message' = Meta July 2025+ per-message pricing. 'per_conversation' = legacy 24h conversation-window pricing. Admin dashboard shows estimated costs under both models for comparison.

legacyConversationRates._comment: Legacy per-conversation rates (USD) by category and country. Used for comparison display only when pricingModel is per_message.

tiered_fallback.description: US-880: Three-tier progressive escalation for unrecognised messages.

tier1.en: I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you rephrase or give me more detail? I'm happy to help!
tier1.ms: Maaf, saya kurang faham. Boleh anda ulang dengan cara lain atau beri lebih butiran? Saya sedia membantu!
tier1.zh: 抱歉，我没太明白您的意思。能换个方式或提供更多详情吗？我很乐意帮忙！
tier1.ta: மன்னிக்கவும், நான் புரிந்துகொள்ளவில்லை. வேறொரு விதத்தில் சொல்ல முடியுமா? நான் உதவ தயாராக இருக்கிறேன்!

hallucination_detection.description: US-913: Two-stage hallucination detection — Stage 1 factual query classifier + Stage 2 NLI claim verification against KB.

call_escalation.description: US-887: Click-to-call escalation button. Sends a WhatsApp call button alongside the holding message during business hours. Only active for listed profiles.

sticker_responses.description: US-923: WhatsApp sticker response for Malaysian festive season engagement. When festive keywords are matched, send branded stickers alongside greeting text.

templateLinter.description: Real-time utility template linter (US-1013). Flags marketing phrases in templates categorised as 'utility' to prevent cost reclassification (Meta July 2025 pricing update).

mm_lite.description: US-1007: Meta Marketing Messages Lite (MM Lite) API settings. When mm_lite_enabled is true, marketing template sends are routed via Cloud API with ttl.seconds set to improve delivery rates by up to 30%. Admin can override TTL per campaign. Default TTL is 30 days (720h).

ai_decision_disclosure.disclosure_template: This recommendation was generated by Rainbow AI (automated system). Reply *human* at any time to request a human staff review before this action is finalised.
ai_decision_disclosure.description: US-1010: Malaysia PDPA 2025 PCP 3/2025 - AI decision disclosure and right to human review. When enabled, guests receive a disclosure message for material AI-driven decisions and can request human review before finalisation.
